titleByLocale.fr: Thérapeute de beauté et de massage (h/f/d)

jobs.description:
Your key responsibilities

  • You are a passionate and highly skilled professional with a strong background in beauty and aesthetics.

  • Your primary focus is on delivering an exceptional range of beauty treatments, including waxing, manicure, pedicure, make-up, and advanced facial treatments, executed with the highest level of precision, care, and attention to detail.

  • With your refined technique and natural sense of service, you create a personalized and indulgent experience, ensuring each guest feels truly pampered, valued, and at ease.

  • Knowledge of relaxing massage techniques is considered an asset, allowing you to further enhance the holistic wellness experience we offer.

  • You thrive in a collaborative Spa environment, contributing to a seamless operation and upholding the highest standards of excellence and guest satisfaction.


• What you bring to the job

For this diverse and rewarding position, you ideally bring the following:

  • A professional qualification with solid practical experience in the above-mentioned areas, preferably within a 5-star luxury hospitality environment.

  • Excellent language skills in English; additional knowledge of Italian and German is highly desirable.

  • A natural flair for sales, combined with strong interpersonal skills and a genuine passion for guest interaction.

  • A high level of commitment, resilience, and flexibility in a dynamic environment.

  • A well-groomed appearance and impeccable manners, reflecting the standards of a luxury establishment.


Our offer

  • Fixed-term seasonal contract from the end of November 2026 until the end of March 2027, with the opportunity to return for future seasons.

  • 5-day working week, averaging 43.5 hours.

  • 5 weeks of holiday and 6 public holidays per year (pro rata).

  • 13th salary from the start date (pro rata temporis).

  • Accommodation available upon request in one of our attractive staff residences.

  • Dining facilities in our modern staff restaurant.

  • The opportunity to work in a prestigious environment with excellent development prospects.


If you are looking for an interesting, challenging, and varied role in a dynamic environment and would like to join a well-established team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.


Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

  • As Director of Brand & Marketing, you will have overall responsibility for the Badrutt's Palace brand and marketing across all touchpoints, including the hotel, restaurants, bars, spa, retail, and events.

  • You will continuously evolve the brand positioning, identity, tone of voice, and visual expression, ensuring a consistent and exceptional brand experience.

  • Leading the Brand & Marketing team, you will foster a culture of brand excellence, cultural awareness, and creativity.

  • The brand's entire digital ecosystem—including website experience, social media, content, paid media, and SEO/GEO/SEM—will be under your strategic direction.

  • You will further develop the hotel's distinctive social media and content strategy, placing cultural relevance and a clearly defined luxury brand code at the heart of every initiative.

  • As the owner of the CRM strategy, you will strengthen guest relationships, drive loyalty, and create long-term value across the luxury guest journey.

  • Relevant KPIs will be defined, monitored, and managed by you to ensure transparency, measure performance, and deliver sustainable business impact.

  • You will lead external agencies and strategic partners with a clear focus on quality, creativity, and brand consistency.


• What you bring to the job

  • You have a refined understanding of ultra-luxury, aesthetics, language, and brand excellence.

  • Several years of experience in a senior Brand and/or Marketing leadership role within a premium or luxury environment enable you to shape brands with confidence and strategic vision.

  • You have a proven track record of leading teams at management or executive level.

  • Your expertise spans the full digital ecosystem, including social media, content, performance marketing, web, and CRM.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, combined with strong decision-making and execution capabilities, enables you to deliver measurable business impact.

  • You are confident in managing and influencing senior internal and external stakeholders.

  • You communicate fluently in English; proficiency in German is an advantage.

  • You thrive in a demanding, seasonal luxury hospitality environment and embrace the pace and expectations that come with it.


Our offer

  • A permanent, year-round position in one of the most unique Brand leadership roles in international luxury hospitality.

As Assistant Head of Technical Services, you support the Head of Technical Services in the operational management and ongoing development of all technical areas within our property.   • Leading the service team in Le Grand Hall, our iconic all-day dining venue and lounge, you will have operational responsibility for one of our hotel's signature dining venues, serving among other things authentic Indian cuisine and specialities from our pastry kitchen.

  • Daily restaurant operations, including table allocation and guest flow, will fall under your responsibility, ensuring both outstanding service and optimal operational performance.

  • Creating memorable guest experiences through warm hospitality and personalised service will be at the heart of your role.

  • Working closely with the Executive Chef, Bar team and other departments, you will maintain the highest standards in food and beverage presentation and service delivery.

  • You will take ownership of recruiting, developing and managing the service team, ensuring the highest levels of engagement, performance and service excellence.

  • Close collaboration with the Events team and other hotel departments will ensure the smooth execution of private functions and special occasions hosted in Le Grand Hall.

  • Supporting management with operational reporting, cost analysis, budgeting and forecasting will contribute to the ongoing success of the outlet.

• What you bring to the job

  • Several years of management experience within a luxury restaurant or five-star hotel, ideally in a Restaurant Manager or comparable leadership role.

  • A natural leader with the ability to motivate, inspire and develop teams while creating a positive and professional working environment.

  • A confident, polished and service-oriented personality, combined with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • A genuine passion for luxury hospitality and delivering personalised guest experiences of the highest standard.

  • Strong organisational skills, sound commercial awareness and the ability to remain calm and solution-oriented in a fast-paced environment.

  • Fluency in English is essential. Either German or Italian is required.

Our offer

  • 10-month contract, start to be discussed, with the possibility to renew from November 2027.

  • 5-day working week averaging 43.5 hours, with 5 weeks' holiday and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th month's salary from the start of employment (pro rata temporis).

  • Accommodation in one of our new staff houses.

  • Meals available in our new and modern staff restaurant.

  • Opportunity to work in an attractive environment with development and career growth opportunities.

If you are passionate about creating exceptional guest experiences and enjoy leading a team in one of Switzerland's most iconic luxury hotels, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.

Recruitment Fraud Warning
Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

jobs.title: Reservations Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:

  • Sie übernehmen die Führungsrolle im Reservierungsteam, bestehend aus fünf Spezialisten, und tragen die Verantwortung für den reibungslosten Ablauf der Reservierungsabteilung.

  • Sie verantworten die selbstständige Bearbeitung von Individual- und Gruppenbuchungen, und stellen dabei jederzeit eine strukturierte und verlässliche Arbeitsweise sicher.

  • Sie unterstützen den Revenue Manager bei der optimalen Preis- und Verfügbarkeitssteuerung sowie bei der Analyse von Buchungs- und Marktentwicklungen.

  • Ihre Berichte für das Management sind präzise und aussagekräftig, um eine fundierte Entscheidungsfindung zu ermöglichen.

  • Die Einführung, Schulung und Weiterentwicklung neuer Mitarbeitender in der Reservationsabteilung gehört ebenso zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich wie die laufende Unterstützung des bestehenden Teams.

  • Gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team arbeiten Sie kontinuierlich an der Optimierung der Abläufe in der Abteilung.

  • Die effektive Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungen Front Office, Sales & Marketing sowie dem Event Team liegt Ihnen am Herzen, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Sie verfügen über mehrjährige, fundierte Berufserfahrung im Front Office und/oder in der Reservierungsabteilung von Luxushotels, idealerweise in einer leitenden Funktion.

  • Ihr souveränes und stilsicheres Auftreten sowie Ihre ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke ermöglichen Ihnen eine professionelle und überzeugende Interaktion auf allen Ebenen – schriftlich wie mündlich.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt; Italienisch sowie weitere Fremdsprachen sind von Vorteil.

  • Sie sind sehr versiert im Umgang mit MS Office und verfügen über fundierte Anwenderkenntnisse in Protel oder vergleichbaren Reservierungssystemen.

  • Sie zeichnen sich durch eine strukturierte, vorausschauende und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus und sind es gewohnt, Verantwortung zu übernehmen sowie Teams fachlich zu führen und zu unterstützen.

  • Ihr sicheres, gewinnendes Auftreten sowie ausgezeichnete Umgangsformen entsprechen den hohen Standards der Luxushotellerie.
